about: The epistola of the formulary “3rd Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Dearly beloved: Be humbled under the powerful hand of God, so that He may lift you up in the time of visitation, casting all your anxiety on Him, for He is concerned for you. Be sober and keep watch, because your adversary the devil circles about like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour. Resist him, strong in faith, aware that the same suffering comes upon your brotherhood that is in the world. And the God of all grace, who called us to His everlasting glory in Christ Jesus — He Himself will perfect, confirm and establish us, who have suffered for a short while. To Him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
